basis: The scatter plot 'Weeks with Promotional Campaigns: Ad Spend vs Sales' shows a strong positive linear relationship across 6 weeks. As Advertising Spend (x-axis, $ thousands) increases from $0 to $60k, Sales (y-axis, $ thousands) consistently rise from $0 to $190k. The data points (Weeks 1-6) align closely along an upward trend, indicating that higher ad spend is associated with significantly higher sales revenue. This positive correlation supports the effectiveness of the campaign and justifies expanding the budget to capture further growth.
